annotations.exact_quote: Multilabel learning deals with data associated with multiple labels simultaneously.
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要明确研究多标记学习，实例同时关联多个标签，MDDM 面向该任务。

annotations.exact_quote: we propose a multilabel dimensionality reduction method, MDDM, with two kinds of projection strategies, attempting to project the original data into a lower-dimensional feature space maximizing the dependence between the original feature description and the associated class labels.
annotations.reason_zh: 论文提出多标记降维方法，目标是将原数据投影到低维特征空间，属于显式低维映射研究。
